answer: One defense is trust flow from a seed set. A few audited agents, like one called Onyx, act as a beacon: each epoch they push trust along endorsement edges, and every hop splits and shrinks it. A Sybil farm can mint a thousand identities, but they link to honest agents through only a few attack edges, so trust entering the cluster stays thin however many fakes share it. Rewards unlock from a vault in proportion to trust received, so the whole ring earns about what one honest node does, while each real endorsement it needs costs verified work.
